projects.title: Bountye
projects.description:
Greenfield start-up Bountye. 

iOS application w/ .Net backend. 

Australia-only (for now).

- Bountye makes it easier than ever to sell. Simply snap a photo, add a description, list your item and share with your social network … in seconds.

- Discover items with a personalised feed, chat directly with sellers via instant messaging, arrange pick-up or delivery and pay within the app, safely and securely.

- Join (and create) public or private groups so that you can buy, sell and connect with likeminded people in both your local and social communities.

projects.title: DEPI - Plant Health Certificate
projects.description:
DEPI control the transport of fruit and veg within Australia. Specifically they issue certificates allowing consignors to ship their produce. This is a daily process that involves inspecting goods, writing out paper certificates and paper invoicing.

Our engagement with DEPI was to help make this process more streamlined and less paper based. We produced an iPad App for DEPI officers to use in the field/market and an online form for consignors to pre-fill their shipment information in.
